Sample_data_processing_1: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to hg19 whole genome using HISAT2  v2.1.0 with default  parameters.
Sample_data_processing_2: The gene expression level was calculated by Cufflinks (v 2.2.1).
Sample_data_processing_3: Reads Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (RPKM) were calculated using a protocol from Chepelev et al., Nucleic Acids Research, 2009. In short, exons from all isoforms of a gene were merged to create one meta-transcript. The number of reads falling in the exons of this meta-transcript were counted and normalized by the size of the meta-transcript and by the size of the library.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1_1: For all CRC patient samples, 50 mg tissue was used for RNA extraction. Total RNA was extracted by using CWBIO Ultrapure RNA Kit (CW0581M).
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1_2: RNA-seq libraries were constructed by NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB E7490) and NEBNext Ultra II Non-Directional RNA Second Strand Synthesis Module (NEB E6111).
Sample_data_processing_1: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to hg19 whole genome using HISAT2  v2.1.0 with default  parameters.
Sample_data_processing_2: The gene expression level was calculated by Cufflinks (v 2.2.1).
Sample_data_processing_3: Reads Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (RPKM) were calculated using a protocol from Chepelev et al., Nucleic Acids Research, 2009. In short, exons from all isoforms of a gene were merged to create one meta-transcript. The number of reads falling in the exons of this meta-transcript were counted and normalized by the size of the meta-transcript and by the size of the library.
Sample_data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include RPKM values for each sample.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1_1: For all CRC patient samples, 50 mg tissue was used for RNA extraction. Total RNA was extracted by using CWBIO Ultrapure RNA Kit (CW0581M).
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1_2: RNA-seq libraries were constructed by NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB E7490) and NEBNext Ultra II Non-Directional RNA Second Strand Synthesis Module (NEB E6111).
Sample_data_processing_1: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to hg19 whole genome using HISAT2  v2.1.0 with default  parameters.
Sample_data_processing_2: The gene expression level was calculated by Cufflinks (v 2.2.1).
Sample_data_processing_3: Reads Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (RPKM) were calculated using a protocol from Chepelev et al., Nucleic Acids Research, 2009. In short, exons from all isoforms of a gene were merged to create one meta-transcript. The number of reads falling in the exons of this meta-transcript were counted and normalized by the size of the meta-transcript and by the size of the library.
Sample_data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include RPKM values for each sample.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1_1: For all CRC patient samples, 50 mg tissue was used for RNA extraction. Total RNA was extracted by using CWBIO Ultrapure RNA Kit (CW0581M).
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1_2: RNA-seq libraries were constructed by NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB E7490) and NEBNext Ultra II Non-Directional RNA Second Strand Synthesis Module (NEB E6111).
Sample_data_processing_1: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to hg19 whole genome using HISAT2  v2.1.0 with default  parameters.
Sample_data_processing_2: The gene expression level was calculated by Cufflinks (v 2.2.1).
Sample_data_processing_3: Reads Per Kilobase of exon per Megabase of library size (RPKM) were calculated using a protocol from Chepelev et al., Nucleic Acids Research, 2009. In short, exons from all isoforms of a gene were merged to create one meta-transcript. The number of reads falling in the exons of this meta-transcript were counted and normalized by the size of the meta-transcript and by the size of the library.
Sample_data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include RPKM values for each sample.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Tissue samples were collected from patients undergoing surgery at the University Hospital of Heidelberg, and were reviewed by pathologists of the Tissue Bank of the National Center for Tumor Diseases to ensure their quality and origin. Gene expression was performed at the Genomic and Proteomics Core Facilities, German Cancer Research Center, Heidelberg, Germany, by using Illumina HumanHT-12 v4 Expression BeadChip.

Sample_hyb_protocol: Hybridisation was performed according to the Illumina standard protocol.
Sample_scan_protocol: Arrays were imaged using Illumina default settings
Sample_data_processing: NA probes were removed and remaining data were log2 transformed and normalised using quantile normalisation

Sample_scan_protocol: Human Genome U219 array plates were scanned according to manufacturer's recommendations (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA).
Sample_data_processing: The Robust Multi-array Average (RMA) algorithm was used for data normalization through R and Bioconductor.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted from tissue samples using a miRCURY™ RNA Isolation Kit (Exiqon) according to manufacturer’s protocol, quantified by NanoDrop® ND-1000 Spectrophotometer (Nanodrop technologies, Wilmington, DE) and stored at -80°C. The quality of these RNA samples was further checked using RNA 600 Nano chip (Agilent Bioanalyzer) and was confirmed by gel electrophoresis.
Sample_label_protocol_ch1: RNA was labeled with the 3'-IVT Labeling Kit (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA) following the manufacturer's protocols.
Sample_hyb_protocol: RNA hybridization was performed through the Affymetrix Human Genome U219 microarrays, using the 96-array plate format on the GeneTitan system and following the manufacturer's recommendations (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA). A blocked experimental design was implemented to avoid biases.
Sample_scan_protocol: Human Genome U219 array plates were scanned according to manufacturer's recommendations (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA).
Sample_data_processing: The Robust Multi-array Average (RMA) algorithm was used for data normalization through R and Bioconductor.

Sample_label_protocol_ch1: RNA was labeled with the 3'-IVT Labeling Kit (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA) following the manufacturer's protocols.
Sample_hyb_protocol: RNA hybridization was performed through the Affymetrix Human Genome U219 microarrays, using the 96-array plate format on the GeneTitan system and following the manufacturer's recommendations (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA). A blocked experimental design was implemented to avoid biases.
Sample_scan_protocol: Human Genome U219 array plates were scanned according to manufacturer's recommendations (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, USA).
Sample_data_processing: The Robust Multi-array Average (RMA) algorithm was used for data normalization through R and Bioconductor.
